caption: The drawing depicts a single object composed of several geometric shapes and vibrant colors. At the base, there is a square platform colored in marbled green tones. Resting on this is a pedestal with a rounded, widened bottom that is shaded in shades of green and transitions into blue as it rises, accentuated with two dark brown rings encircling the lower and central portions. Above the pedestal, a large rectangular cuboid sits horizontally, predominantly painted in light salmon-pink with blue edging and dark brown framing. This cuboid features a keyhole in its center, suggesting it is a drawer or a box. The top of the object is capped with a small, vase-shaped form colored in light pink with a thin brown rim. The background is plain off-white, and the composition is centrally placed on the page. The artist's name, “HARRY MARK WADDELL,” is written in small, neat letters below the base of the object, with additional faint pencil notes visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Candlestick (Ecclesiastical)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
